writing.overall_comment: A solid conceptual testing reference, but it would be more actionable with concrete runnable examples and deeper language-specific failure-path coverage.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and description accurately summarize a comprehensive testing skill covering unit/integration tests, TDD/BDD, mocks, and automation guidance.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The document provides useful naming, assertion, mocking, and boundary-condition examples, but most examples are templates or snippets rather than concrete failure-path test cases.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: It gives clear high-level workflows and response steps, yet lacks runnable language-specific commands, complete test samples, or unambiguous implementation details.

suggestions: In the workflow/response-steps sections, add runnable language-specific commands and complete copy-paste test samples so readers can execute the guidance without translating templates.
In the examples & edge cases section, add concrete failure-path test cases that show expected failures and assertions instead of relying mostly on templates or snippets.
In the implementation guidance, add unambiguous step-by-step details for setup and sequencing so the workflow leaves no implementation choices implicit.
